name: taxcal
description: Tax.cal — estimate the total tax you really pay (income tax, social contributions, VAT/GST/sales tax and fuel duty) in 11 countries: UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Ireland, Germany, France, Netherlands, Spain, Italy and India. One deterministic engine powers the website and the Tax.cal ChatGPT plugin (MCP server).

scripts.build:all: node scripts/build-core.mjs && node build-country-pages.mjs && node build-guide-pages.mjs && node build-compare-page.mjs && node build-artifact.mjs
